title: Nim Game
description:
You are playing a game with n stones.

Rules:

You go first
Players take turns
On each turn, you can remove 1, 2, or 3 stones
The player who removes the last stone wins

Your task:

Return true if you can win (assuming both play optimally)
Otherwise, return false

Example 1
Input: n = 4
Output: false

Example 2
Input: n = 1
Output: true

Example 3
Input: n = 2
Output: true

Constraints:

1 <= n <= 2^31 - 1
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
